perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.desc: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Eddy Current
perks.desc: Temporarily increases reload speed and handling after sprinting or while amplified. This effect is improved when you are amplified.

perks.name: Reconstruction
perks.desc: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.

perks.name: Triple Tap
perks.desc: Rapidly landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.desc: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Rolling Storm
perks.desc:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge.

perks.name: Jolting Feedback
perks.desc:
Dealing repeated damage with this weapon inflicts Jolt. 

While amplified, Jolt is applied faster.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Killing Tally
perks.desc: Kills increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded.

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.desc: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.

perks.name: Tex Balanced Stock
perks.desc: Damaging targets while firing from the hip increases handling, reload speed, and movement speed while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Gravity Well
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon automatically gathers nearby ammo.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 139 from 13 May 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/0m6Sfdv88fNZmYm9A6PdVR?si=140d643338154357) with @ImpetusAlways @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for clearing Minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. Unfortunately, Terminus Horizon is in the weakest subfamily for damage, so you can pass if you already have a well-rolled arc LMG. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats are good - d2foundry.gg calculates that 64 Range equates to 47.88m ADS and 29.93m hipfire before damage dropoff, 25 Stability is ×1.1112 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 38 Handling is 0.40s ready, 0.41s ADS and 0.38s stow speed, 24 Reload Speed is a 5.44s reload, Recoil Direction is 74, Zoom is 17, and magazine size is 46 (max 73). With 0/1/2/3 reserves mods, total ammo is 382/427/472/495 (max 495). A little bit of Stability and Handling from the barrel perk are useful to improve gunfeel and control. For the magazine perk, pretty much any is useable, except maybe Extended Mag. You might use this with double special as a heavy pseudo-scout rifle for general add clearing, in which case the double damage perks of Dragonfly for an arc AoE explosion on a crit kill, and Killing Tally for up to ×1.3 damage after three kills for as long as you don't reload or stow. The Tex Balanced Stock is there if you like hipfiring, but the Gravity Well origin trait can be very useful to pick up ammo bricks within 5m on a manual reload. Recommended MW: Handling, Stability or Reload Speed, with an Adept Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Ionic Traces or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader.

warlockmaggie (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Yeehaw, the Terminus Horizon is back to round out our rodeo! With new Arc perks as well as the ever-powerful Reconstruction + Killing Tally, there's some solid choices for this High-Impact Machine Gun. I'm particularly looking forward to trying out Triple Tap and Precision Instrument to see how that plays together. This archetype does suffer from an abysmal reload speed and stability, so fix those as you can." Recommended MW: Stability or Reload Speed

warlockmaggie (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Terminus Horizon is a weapon that has PvP potential, it just has some hurdles to overcome. Once you deal with the Stability, you should have an easier time landing shots and that's where the perks come in. Pick your favorite 3rd column perk (Eddy Current seems like a strong option) and damage bonus and you're in business. Of special note, Killing Tally can 3 crit all Resilience levels at 3 stacks (a jaw dropping 0.33s ttk )@" Recommended MW: Range or Stability
